name: wiki-forge
description: Turn your AI agent into a knowledge compiler. Feed sources once, build a persistent cross-referenced wiki that compounds over time. Ships eleven skills (capture, ingest, query, graph, summarize, lint, log, overview, triage, retract, init) and four subagents (ingestor, librarian, linter, curator), plus hybrid BM25+semantic search, split indices, contradiction tracking, typed cross-references, graph analysis with user-facing path/neighbor/subgraph queries, topic-coverage reports (five-section audit via two-shape retrieval), structured telemetry (5 JSONLs covering ingest/query/lint/overview/source-freshness), pre-write secret scanning, content-drift polling, per-domain URL classification with stdlib raw-HTML metadata extraction (OG / JSON-LD / article:tag / arXiv citation_*) for capture-side source_tags parity with browser-clipper onramps, and a recurring scale-breakdown audit probe runner with five hard re-audit triggers for early detection of authoring-side scaling failure modes. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Default install is generic wiki-only; pass /wiki-init --dual-claude to additionally bootstrap the wiki-side identity files and SessionStart hook for a dual-Claude (wiki + clipper) project shape.
